description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for the USB-C Protocol Layer (PRL) in Zephyr OS, including message handling, state machines, and reset procedures.

methods.name: prl_subsys_init
methods.description: Initializes the Protocol Layer subsystem; should only be called during system init.

methods.name: prl_start
methods.description: Starts the Protocol Layer state machine, typically invoked from the Type-C state machine.

methods.name: prl_first_msg_notificaiton
methods.description: Notifies the Protocol Layer that the first message in an Active Message Sequence (AMS) is being sent.

methods.name: prl_suspend
methods.description: Suspends the Protocol Layer state machine, called from the Type-C state machine.

methods.name: prl_reset
methods.description: Resets the Protocol Layer state machine.

methods.name: prl_run
methods.description: Runs the Protocol Layer state machine, called from the port stack thread.

methods.name: prl_hard_reset_complete
methods.description: Signals that a hard reset has been completed.

methods.name: prl_set_rev
methods.description: Sets the revision received from the port partner for a specific packet type.

methods.name: prl_get_rev
methods.description: Retrieves the revision associated with a specific packet type.

methods.name: prl_send_ctrl_msg
methods.description: Instructs the Protocol Layer to send a Power Delivery control message.

methods.name: prl_send_data_msg
methods.description: Instructs the Protocol Layer to send a Power Delivery data message.

methods.name: prl_execute_hard_reset
methods.description: Commands the Protocol Layer to execute a hard reset.

methods.name: prl_is_running
methods.description: Checks if the Protocol Layer is currently running.
